method: Live headless Chromium observation plus source inspection

already_present: Seven distinct specialist and Planner roles
Frozen farm or scenario conversation state with optional selected bed
Specific-message replies, advisor invitation, full-council action and recorded replay
Supported scalar proposed-action handoff into Scenario Lab
Three-stage local numerical experiment and strategy comparison
44px composer controls, device-keyboard voice hint and reduced-motion support
needs_reinforcement: Selected context is a single plain-text bed reference and disappears behind the modal sheet
Every message-count change smoothly scrolls the transcript to its end
Farmer steering actions are disabled while a response is active
Full council presentation does not explain why each contribution is necessary
Message evidence, board highlights and persistent before/after quantities are weakly connected
missing: Removable multi-object context for beds, crops, orders and harvest windows
Explicit ambiguity clarification before interpreting contextual references
Contextual Show evidence, Correct assumption and Consider another option actions
Unresolved or rejected recommendation state attached to a visible plan version

limitations: Responsive checks use headless Chromium emulation, not physical mobile hardware.
The software keyboard, native dictation, audio, and real touch accuracy were not observed.
Provider response pacing and active-request interruption were inspected in source and prior recorded evidence; no paid behavior was invoked.
A repeat run was stopped when the production admission limit returned HTTP 429; no attempt was made to bypass the limit.
